sections.title: EXPLORE OUR COLLECTIONS
sections.sub: Dressed in tradition, crafted for celebration
sections.intro: From the bride's lehenga to the groom's sherwani, juti, saafas and jewellery, every piece is chosen for craftsmanship and comfort, and is available to rent for your celebration.

sections.title: BOOK YOUR BEAUTY SESSION
sections.sub: Reserve your glow for the big day
sections.intro: Our beauty studio offers bridal makeup, hair, skin and nail services with experienced artists. Pick a service below and reserve your slot in a few taps.

sections.title: PARLOUR SERVICES
sections.sub: Every look, perfected by our artists
sections.intro: Explore every service we offer, from everyday grooming to complete pre-bridal care, all under one roof and tailored to your look.

sections.title: TRENDING THIS WEDDING SEASON
sections.sub: The pieces everyone is asking for this season
sections.intro: A curated mix of the designs customers are renting most this wedding season, across bridal wear, groomswear, jewellery and festive outfits.

sections.title: SPOTLIGHT
sections.intro: Our stylists' favourite pieces in each category, framed to show off the detail. Tap any design to view it in full and book it for your dates.

sections.heading: Two outfits, one beautiful story.
sections.text: Coordinated lehengas and sherwanis in matching colours and craft, so you both look like one story from the first photo to the last.
items: Perfectly matched lehenga and sherwani sets
Hand-finished zari, kundan and resham work
Free fitting trial and basic alterations

sections.heading: Learn the craft, not just book it.
sections.text: Makeup, hair and nail artistry courses taught by our in-house team, from beginner to professional, with hands-on practice on real bridal looks.

sections.title: GALLERY
sections.intro: A glimpse of the styles, colours and craftsmanship that fill our showroom. Browse the frames, then open the full gallery for more.

sections.title: ABOUT UTSAV
sections.text: From the mehendi night to the wedding morning, Utsav dresses, adorns and styles the whole celebration. Rent bridal lehengas, sherwanis, kundan jewellery and juti, and book your bridal makeup and pre-bridal packages with us.

sections.title: CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
sections.intro: Every celebration we dress leaves us with a story. Here is what a few customers shared with us, and we would love to hear yours too.

categories.name: Bride
categories.desc: Heirloom lehengas in zari, velvet and silk, styled for the most important walk of your life.
categories.blurb: Choose from heirloom lehengas in rich zari and velvet. Each outfit is cleaned, pressed and fitted before your big day.

categories.name: Groom
categories.desc: Sherwanis, indo-westerns and bandhgalas tailored for a groom who owns the mandap.
categories.blurb: From classic sherwanis to modern indo-westerns, every piece is tailored for comfort and a confident entry.

categories.name: Bride Jewel
categories.desc: Kundan, polki and pearl sets that complete every bridal look with timeless shine.
categories.blurb: Kundan, polki and pearl sets that pair beautifully with every bridal outfit. Insured, polished and ready to wear.

categories.name: Groom Jewel
categories.desc: Layered pearl malas, brooches and kalgis that add a regal finish to the groom's look.
categories.blurb: Pearl malas, brooches and finishing touches chosen to complement the groom's sherwani and safa.

categories.name: Bride Juti
categories.desc: Hand-embroidered juti and mojari, comfortable for every ritual from haldi to pheras.
categories.blurb: Embroidered juti in soft cushioned soles, made for long ceremonies and every ritual.

categories.name: Groom Juti
categories.desc: Classic mojdi and juti in velvet, zari and silk to match every sherwani.
categories.blurb: Handcrafted mojdi in velvet, zari and silk. Easy to match with any sherwani or kurta.

categories.name: Garba Dress
categories.desc: Vibrant chaniya cholis and garba sets made for twirling through the nine nights.
categories.blurb: Colourful chaniya cholis built for movement, with mirror work and bright borders for the nine nights.

categories.name: Saafas
categories.desc: Pagdi and saafa in rich colours, tied to perfection for baraat and rituals.
categories.blurb: Ready-tied and custom-tied saafas in rich colours, with brooch and kalgi options available.

categories.name: Festival For Women
categories.desc: Festive sarees and suits that bring grace and glow to every family celebration.
categories.blurb: Festive outfits for every family occasion, from Diwali evenings to Karwa Chauth, ready to wear.

categories.name: Festival For Men
categories.desc: Kurta sets and nehru jackets for festive evenings with family.
categories.blurb: Kurta sets and jackets for festive gatherings, in colours that look as good in photos as in person.

categories.name: Couple Sets
categories.desc: Perfectly matched sets for the pair, coordinated in colour, cut and craft.
categories.blurb: Matching outfits for the pair, chosen together so you look coordinated in every photo.

categories.name: Bridal Makeup
categories.desc: Long-lasting, camera-ready bridal looks by our artists, from HD base to final dupatta setting.
categories.blurb: A trial look, HD base and long-lasting finish by artists who understand Indian bridal styles.

categories.name: Party Makeup
categories.desc: Soft glam and party looks that keep you radiant from first guest to last dance.
categories.blurb: Soft glam for parties, engagements and family functions, finished to last through the evening.

categories.name: Hair Styling
categories.desc: Elegant open styles, curls and braids finished with jewelled hair accessories.
categories.blurb: Waves, braids and curls styled with jewelled accessories to match your outfit.

categories.name: Hair Bunching
categories.desc: Classic juda, floral buns and bridal updos set to last through every ritual.
categories.blurb: Traditional and floral buns set securely, so your hair stays perfect from ritual to reception.

categories.name: Hair Cutting
categories.desc: Precision cuts and trims shaped to suit your face and your festive look.
categories.blurb: Consultation-led cuts and trims that suit your face shape and your event look.

categories.name: Facial & Skin Care
categories.desc: Glow facials and skin rituals that prepare you for the big day.
categories.blurb: Cleansing, glow and hydration treatments that prepare your skin for the camera.

categories.name: Threading & Eyebrows
categories.desc: Clean threading and shaping to frame your face for every occasion.
categories.blurb: Precise threading and shaping for a clean, polished look in minutes.

categories.name: Nail Art
categories.desc: Bridal and party nail art with gold foil, stones and delicate detail.
categories.blurb: Hand-painted designs with gold foil and stones, matched to your outfit colours.

categories.name: Nail Care
categories.desc: Manicures and pedicures that leave hands and feet soft, polished and wedding-ready.
categories.blurb: Relaxing manicure and pedicure care for soft hands and neatly finished nails.
